title: Loan Servicing Waterfall Recompute
description: Independently recomputes how a single borrower's single loan payment applies across escrow, fee, interest and principal buckets under the note's own caller-declared bucket application order, then diffs the recomputed per-bucket breakdown against the core's actual applied amounts. The application order, pre-payment bucket balances and payment amount are all caller-declared contract terms -- this node asserts no universal statutory application order and infers none. Verdict is MATCHES, DIVERGES (with per-bucket deltas), or INDETERMINATE whenever a required input -- a declared bucket's balance, or the core's applied breakdown to diff against -- is absent. Recompute and receipt only; this is not a claim that either side's figure is the legally correct one.

application_order.description: Ordered, unique, non-empty list of bucket ids the note's own payment-application order declares (e.g. late_fee, escrow_shortage, escrow, interest, principal). A contract term -- never chosen or inferred by this tool.

bucket_balances.description: Map of bucket id -> pre-payment owed balance, in integer minor units (cents). Every bucket named in application_order must have an entry here.

payment_amount.description: The payment amount to allocate, in integer minor units (cents).

core_applied.description: Optional: the core's actual applied breakdown, bucket id -> integer minor units, to diff against the recomputed allocation. Omitted -> verdict INDETERMINATE.

mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes a single loan payment's application across caller-declared buckets under the note's own bucket application order, and diffs the result against the core's actual applied breakdown, returning MATCHES, DIVERGES (per-bucket deltas), or INDETERMINATE.

source: authored by CORE-VERIFY-LOANWFALL-1 per CORE-VERIFY-BUILD-SPEC.md's §5, loan-servicing payment-application waterfall recompute chain. Positioning guardrails: independently recompute and receipt only, never a claim of core-vendor endorsement or a universal statutory application order.
